title: Invariance under equal register states
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, let $B$ be a natural number, let $st$ and $st'$ be machine states, let $l$ be a machine label, and let $c$ be an abstract configuration. If $st=st'$ and the machine reaches $c$ from label $l$ with register vector given by $st'$, while satisfying the guard that every intermediate configuration has valid preconditions and all register values at most $B$, then it also reaches $c$ from label $l$ with register vector given by $st$, under the same guard.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a bit string and $B$ a natural number. For states $st,st'$, a machine label
$l$, and a configuration $c$, if $st=st'$ and the machine can reach $c$ from label $l$
with register vector $st'$ under the bounded-run condition, then it can reach $c$ from
label $l$ with register vector $st$ under the same condition.
